summary: Tested Patch Canvas /builder (Next.js 16 app on sycord-pages) end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass for GET /builder, POST /api/builder/export (valid + invalid), and POST /api/builder/stream (SSE start/patch/done + invalid handling). Frontend: All UI flows pass — 4-panel shell visible, 3 viewport iframes in 'All' mode and 1 in 'Desktop', component tree selection populates property inspector, editing inspector-text dispatches a JSON Patch ('replace /pages/0/tree/children/0/children/0/children/0/text = ...') visible in the PATCHES & CODE panel, undo/redo toggle correctly, mode routing surfaces 'Send (fast)' when a node is selected, and the preview iframe has sandbox='allow-scripts'.

issues: Uses cdn.tailwindcss.com inside iframe — console warns it should not be used in production. Consider inlining required Tailwind utilities or moving to a small static stylesheet to avoid runtime CDN dependency.

other_console_warnings: On /builder initial load one resource returned HTTP 500 (no impact on UI behavior, all panels and APIs functional). Likely a non-critical asset/route — main agent may want to check server logs to identify and silence it.

action_items: Investigate the single 500 response observed during /builder page load (check Next.js server logs for the failing resource — likely a webpack chunk, favicon, or RSC payload).
Replace cdn.tailwindcss.com in the iframe preview document with a precompiled stylesheet to remove the production warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Builder document IR is well-typed (Zod discriminated union on 'component') and the export endpoint correctly validates and returns issues with 422 for malformed payloads.
Stream endpoint correctly produces SSE with named events (start/patch/done) and Content-Type text/event-stream.
Iframe is sandboxed with allow-scripts only (no allow-same-origin) which is the correct security posture for an LLM-driven preview.
The mini-renderer iframe relies on tailwind CDN; for offline / CSP-strict environments this will break — consider bundling styles.
seed_data_creation: None — tests build payload in-memory matching createDefaultDocument().
context_for_next_testing_agent: BuilderDocument schema (lib/ai-ui-builder/catalog/schemas.ts) requires keys: id, version(int), componentCatalogVersion, theme, state, history, routes, pages. Nodes use 'component' discriminator (NOT 'type'), and Heading/Text store the literal copy in a top-level 'text' field on the node, not in props. Use createDefaultDocument() shape from lib/ai-ui-builder/document/default-document.ts as a known-valid payload. The PATCHES & CODE panel renders patch ops as 'replace /pages/0/tree/children/.../text = "..."'. Tree-node 'node-hero-heading' selection populates [data-testid=inspector-text]; editing then blurring dispatches the patch. Undo enables after a patch, redo enables after undo. SSE stream endpoint can take up to ~30s for fast mode; tests wait up to 60s.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The single observed 500 on /builder load is non-blocking (no impact on shell, panels, APIs, or streaming) and should be investigated via Next.js server logs.
